Pass 40 (built green): chunk designation gate + multi-hop relay hauling (up VERIFIED) + pull-side fetch + cross-level storage-UPGRADE pull + best-of-up/down destination + verdict-cache invalidation on level-change (fixes the downward relay stalling on the intermediate level).
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE (USER DIRECTIVE 2026-07-25)
**NEVER launch tests with the user's full modlist (isolated=false).** ALWAYS isolated=true with a minimal companionMods set (Dubwise.DubsBadHygiene for DBH, Krkr.rule56 for CAI, Mehni.PickUpAndHaul for bulk-haul) + build a fresh column via the dev action "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement". NOTE: the auto-PIN of that palette entry can log "Could not find node from path ... Removing." at startup - run it manually from the debug menu. Non-isolated only if the user explicitly asks.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- Selection survives column view switches AND pawn level-changes. All levels real maps; viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- **See-below = RENDER overlay + per-interaction input hooks, NOT a general see-through.**
- **Designators OUT OF SCOPE (pass 33)** — except we programmatically re-stamp the vanilla Haul designation on a chunk set down mid-relay (p40 FIX 5), internal plumbing.
- Logistics doctrine: every ferry MONOTONE. Storage=vanilla+capacity clamp + delivered-level retention (pass 34).
- **WORK doctrine (pass 36): the column is ONE BIG MAP for work priority.**
- **HAULING / STORAGE-PRIORITY doctrine (pass 37, REFINED p40):** ONE BIG MAP for storage priority. A cross-level storage move fires ONLY when the destination tier STRICTLY beats the best storage the item can reach on its OWN level. Equal/lower never crosses. `TargetLevelFor` evaluates BOTH linked levels and keeps the STRICTLY-HIGHER-priority destination (best-of-up/down, not upper-first). Its per-item verdict cache is invalidated when the item changes map (sourceMapId), so a relay stack re-evaluates on each level. Allow Tool Haul Urgently (ignorePins) still crosses. Monotone.
- **HAULABILITY PARITY (p40, USER-VERIFIED):** non-alwaysHaulable things (stone/slag chunks) only auto-haul when DESIGNATED (Orders->Haul) or in storage; corpses alwaysHaulable, unaffected.
- **MULTI-HOP HAULING (p40, "stop at first level that accepts it"):** move ONE gap at a time, store at the NEAREST accepting level. one-hop-then-relay: `AB_HaulChainAcrossLevels` hop toward the far destination; `CrossLevelHaulChain.OnArrive` stores here if this level accepts, else sets the item down + re-stamps the Haul designation (non-alwaysHaulable only) so the ordinary givers carry it onward. No re-entrant carried-item follow-up job.
- **PULL-SIDE (p40 FIX 6 + 7):** the idle FETCH giver is far-destination aware AND scans a target level's IN-STORAGE items for cross-level UPGRADES (an item in valid best LOCAL storage is dropped from vanilla's haulables lister, so only a pawn on that level would push it). `CanStartFor` intentionally NOT gated on VirtualScanActive.
- **COMBAT:** projectiles spawn on the TARGET map. VISUALS (p38): real 1:1 projectile. FoW (p39): optional CAI 5000.
- **Soft-compat HARD RULE (p35):** foreign types never in a SIGNATURE/field. CAI reflection-only.
- **RE-ENTRANCY HARD RULE (p40):** re-entering a patched vanilla method, a foreign prefix may skip the original and leave nulls; coalesce. Do NOT TryTakeOrderedJob re-entrantly from a stair-transfer callback that carries an item - set it down + re-designate.

# PASS 40 — HAUL/MENU FIX WAVE (BUILT GREEN 0/0, verifying in-game)
- **FIX 1** bulk-haul heavy-stack fallback.
- **FIX 2** cross-level RMB red error (Melee Animation postfix NRE) - coalesce re-entrant result/context.
- **FIX 3** equal-tier storage never crosses.
- **FIX 4** vanilla HAULABILITY PARITY (chunks need Orders->Haul or in-storage). USER-VERIFIED.
- **FIX 5** MULTI-HOP hauling via one-hop-then-relay. USER-VERIFIED upward.
- **FIX 6** FETCH far-destination aware. USER-VERIFIED.
- **FIX 7** cross-level storage-UPGRADE pull (fetch scans in-storage items) + best-of-up/down destination (was upper-first, bounced a downward relay back up).
- **FIX 8** (this pass) verdict-cache invalidation on level-change. The downward relay (sky Normal -> basement Critical) stalled on the surface: `TargetLevelFor` cached a per-thingIDNumber verdict, and the null verdict computed while the item sat on the sky was reused once the same item was set down on the surface (still within the 600t TTL) -> no auto-haul, RMB "no spot configured". Added `sourceMapId` to the cache entry; stale when != the item's current map. (Lore saved under `performance`.)

# PASS 39 — OPTIONAL CAI 5000 (Krkr.rule56) (phases 1-3 built green, pending verify)
# 38 COMBAT VISUALS · 37 STORAGE-PRIORITY HAUL · 36 ONE-BIG-MAP WORK (VERIFIED) · 36b AIM POSE (VERIFIED) · 36c MODDED TURRET · 35 DBH/GRAVSHIP/DELETE/LEVELGEN · 34 · 33 SEE-BELOW INPUT (VERIFIED)

## Modern Dev Tools integration — SHIPPED About/known-issues.json (inert without MDT).

## REMOVED FEATURES
SKYLIGHTS (r7). MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (r12). Stairwell heat exchange. CROSS-LEVEL TRACERS (p38). Equal-tier lateral cross-level storage moves (p40). Auto-haul of UNDESIGNATED loose chunks (p40). Carried-item re-entrant multi-hop continuation (p40). Upper-first destination pick (p40, now best-of-up/down).

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · mech charge · bill supply + mech RMB · p33 see-below input · p36 work priority · p36b aim pose · **p40 chunk gate (FIX 4), multi-hop relay upward (FIX 5), pull-side fetch (FIX 6)**.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE · Biomes! Caverns · Alpha Biomes · BM+MO · Odyssey+VLE · Misc. Robots/++ · **Pick Up And Haul / Hauler's Dream (bulk cross-level; heavy-stack fallback; far chain single-item)** · Allow Tool · Ancient urban ruins · CE (p38) · Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF · Trader Airships, Hospitality · BAM · PO/Dubs Analyzer/TPT · WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage · Modern Dev Tools · Perspective: Ores · CAI 5000 / Krkr.rule56 (p39) · Melee Animation / Float Sub-Menus (p40 coalesce) · turrets: any Building_Turret w/ projectile verb (p36c) · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded, non-projectile/CE-verb turrets across levels.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE (run ISOLATED + dev-built column)
**PASS 40 (TOP):**
- FIX 8/7 (current): items in a Normal SKY stockpile + a Critical BASEMENT stockpile, pawns on the surface -> items must flow sky->surface->basement into Critical and STAY (no stall on the surface, no bounce, RMB on a mid-relay surface item shows a haul option). Also 1-hop (surface Normal -> basement Critical) and reverse (basement Normal -> sky Critical).
- FIX 5/6 re-verify: designated basement chunks -> sky stockpile; stop-at-first-accepting with a surface stockpile.
- FIX 4 (VERIFIED) · FIX 3 (equal priority) · FIX 1 (Mehni.PickUpAndHaul no loop) · FIX 2 (co.uk.epicguru.meleeanimation no red RMB error).
**PASS 39 CAI 5000** (Krkr.rule56). 38 · 37 · 36c · 35 queues.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky+basement · basement/light/RMB/below-view diagnostics · cross-gap combat / auto-engage / targeting-hub self-tests · CAI fog self-test (p39).

## Status
2026-07-26 (pass 40, BUILT GREEN 0/0, verifying in-game): chunk gate + upward multi-hop relay + pull-side fetch USER-VERIFIED. Downward relay (sky Normal -> basement Critical) reported stalling on the surface with RMB "no spot configured"; root cause = `TargetLevelFor`'s per-thingIDNumber verdict cache returning the stale null verdict from when the item was on the sky after it was set down on the surface (FIX 8: sourceMapId invalidation), compounding the upper-first bounce already addressed by FIX 7 (best-of-up/down). Testing ISOLATED + dev column; PUAH + Melee companions.
